properties.name: IsNormalized
properties.description: If this animation should run at a constant apparent rate regardless of game speed setting, then this flag will be set to true.

properties.name: IsGroundLayer
properties.description: If this animation should be rendered and sorted with the other ground units, then this flag is true. Typical of this would be fire and other low altitude animation effects.

properties.name: IsTranslucent
properties.description: If this animation should be rendered in a translucent fashion, this flag will be true. Translucent colors are some of the reds and some of the greys. Typically, smoke and some fire effects have this flag set.

properties.name: IsWhiteTrans
properties.description: If this animation uses the white translucent table, then this flag will be true.

properties.name: IsFlameThrower
properties.description: If this is the special flame thrower animation, then custom affects occur as it is playing. Specifically, scorch marks and little fire pieces appear as the flame jets forth.

properties.name: IsScorcher
properties.description: Some animations leave a scorch mark behind. Napalm and other flame type explosions are typical of this type.

properties.name: IsCraterForming
properties.description: Some explosions are of such violence that they leave craters behind. This flag will be true for those types.

properties.name: IsSticky
properties.description: If this animation should attach itself to any unit that is in the same location as itself, then this flag will be true. Most vehicle impact explosions are of this type.

properties.description: This is the type number for this animation kind. It can be used as a unique identifier for animation types.

properties.name: ChainTo
properties.description: If the animation is to launch into another animation, then the secondary animation will be defined here.

properties.name: VirtualAnim
properties.description: Animation data to use specifically for virtual rendering (implies this animation only for legacy).

properties.name: Size
properties.description: This is the frame that the animation is biggest. The biggest frame of animation will hide any changes to underlying ground (e.g., craters) that the animation causes, so these effects are delayed until this frame is reached. The end result is to prevent the player from seeing craters "pop" into existence.

properties.name: Biggest
properties.description: This is the frame that the animation is biggest. The biggest frame of animation will hide any changes to underlying ground (e.g., craters) that the animation causes, so these effects are delayed until this frame is reached. The end result is to prevent the player from seeing craters "pop" into existence.

properties.name: Damage
properties.description: Some animations (when attached to another object) damage the object it is in contact with. Fire is a good example of this. This value is a fixed point number of the damage that is applied to the attached object every game tick.

properties.name: Delay
properties.description: Simple animation delay value between advancing of frames. This can be overridden by the control list.

properties.name: Start
properties.description: The starting frame number for each animation sequence. Usually this is zero, but can sometimes be different if this animation is a sub sequence of a larger animation file.

properties.name: LoopStart
properties.description: Looping animations might start at a different frame than the initial one. This is true for smoke effects that have a startup sequence followed by a continuous looping sequence.

properties.name: LoopEnd
properties.description: For looping animations, this is the frame that will end all the middle loops of the animation. The last loop of the animation will proceed until the Stages has been fully completed.

properties.name: Stages
properties.description: The number of stages that this animation sequence will progress through before it loops or ends.

properties.name: Loops
properties.description: This is the normal loop count for this animation. Usually this is one, but for some animations, it may be larger.
